Firecrawl announced a $75 million Series B led by Smash Capital, with Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures also participating. Coverage dates the announcement to September 22, 2026, when it also launched Alexandria, a service for giving AI agents access to specialized datasets. No valuation was disclosed.

Some details conflict across sources:
- **Headquarters:** One source says Los Angeles, while another says San Francisco.
- **Founding year:** Coverage cites 2024, but one profile lists 2022.
- **Prior round:** One source gives the Series A as $20.7M, another as $14.5M.
- **Amount:** RuntimeWire reports a Form D showing about $82M in preferred stock sold, roughly $7.1M more than the announced $75M, and says neither disclosure explains the gap.

content.text:
Firecrawl raised a **$75 million** Series B. **Smash Capital** led it. Some sources call the lead investor "Smash Ventures," so the name varies by outlet. Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Y Combinator, Freestyle and Offline Ventures also took part.

It announced **Alexandria** alongside the round. Alexandria is a data library that gives AI agents access to specialized datasets. Coverage dates the announcement to September 22, 2026. No valuation was disclosed.

One outlet, RuntimeWire, reports that a Form D shows about $82M in preferred stock sold. That is roughly $7.1M more than the announced $75M, and neither disclosure explains the gap.

Sources:
- [Web-Scraping Firm Firecrawl Raises $75M Series B Led by Smash Ventures](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/web-scraping-firm-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-led-by-smash-ventures-for-ai)
- [Firecrawl raises $75M Series B to build a knowledge library for AI agents (Dealroom)](https://dealroom.co/news/155341-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-to-build-a-knowledge-library-for-ai-agents/)
- [Firecrawl raises $75M to turn web crawling into an agent data library (RuntimeWire)](https://runtimewire.com/article/firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-alexandria-ai-agent-data)
